items: SEC: Reuters (Fri 2026-11-20, two people briefed) reports SEC enforcement staff are examining potential accounting issues at Nvidia; start date and practices unknown; Nvidia did not immediately respond; SEC declined comment. WSJ reported an SEC investigation on 2026-11-17 without saying why. Possible focus areas named by press (speculation): revenue by customer headquarters instead of billing location (FT: switch came as Singapore-billed sales neared half of revenue) and customer financing guarantees ($118B).

Commerce/BIS interim final rule 'Addressing Remote Access to Advanced Semiconductors' (filed 2026-11-16, effective 2026-11-19): license required for advanced AI chips to Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, Brazil; any data center worldwide giving large compute to China-HQ companies needs a license; existing providers have 90 days; also rescinds the 2025 AI Diffusion Rule. China's commerce ministry objected.

Results 2026-11-17: revenue $115.8B (+103% y/y), data center $107.6B, adj EPS $2.68 vs 2.47 est; Q4 guide $130B +/-3% vs ~$124.8B consensus assuming zero China DC compute; GM guide 71-72%; buyback boosted. Stock rose ~4-5% after hours, then fell 4 straight sessions.

Guarantees: maximum exposure $118B (from $108.5B), $105B credit support for an OpenAI-leased Ohio campus (SB Energy, 9 phases, first in FY2029); no payments made; schedule $6B FY28, $7B FY29... Cash and marketable securities $53.5B. BofA estimated $230B total guarantees (Reuters, 2026-11-16).

Leadership: Chair Harvey Jones said the board will not reinstate Huang (Huang said he would be 'honored' to return); Heidrick & Struggles hired; no timeline. Treasury Sec. Bessent (2026-11-15) urged an outside CEO and a 'dramatic shakeup' and questioned whether illicit chip sales boosted earnings.

Congress: Huang closed-door interview requested by House chairs for 2026-12-01 and Nvidia general counsel 2026-12-02; Senate Banking requested Huang 2026-12-03 and Lutnick 2026-12-10. Nov 18 briefing did not happen.

DOJ charged Super Micro executives with conspiring to divert AI servers to China; Supermicro internal probe found no senior-management involvement. DOJ reviewing Nvidia's planned $12.9B Hugging Face purchase.

Market: Fri 2026-11-20 Nasdaq -5.28%, S&P 500 -3.70%, VIX 35.90; Nasdaq worst week since March 2020; AI-repricing narrative (slowing data-center construction, tighter funding). NVDA -46% to -48% from the 2026-10-06 record close 239.24; seventh straight weekly loss, longest since 2008; market cap ~$3.03T.

Analysts: average target ~$251.74 on 11-18 (Reuters), TradingView average 242.79; median of 24 post-print targets $222.50; Summit Insights cut to Hold; Wells Fargo PT 300->250; earnings estimates for FY ending Jan 2028 up ~23% in 90 days (TIKR).
